purpose: Accumulate raw hits for leading-zero three-family states while preserving the exact five-character strings and using their dense legacy identifier behavior as an explicit null/control class.

policy.rule: Leading-zero targets remain exact five-character strings; 00103 is not silently converted to 103 and raw occurrences have zero automatic physical-evidence weight.
policy.promotion: P1/P2 promotion requires an independently verified physical quantity whose normalization policy explicitly preserves or justifies the leading-zero representation.
policy.namespace_control: Legacy PII/DOI suffixes, grant IDs, method codes and repository identifiers are retained as metadata controls even when they lead to valuable physical-science publications.

information_updates.finding: Leading-zero targets are particularly collision-prone in legacy PII/DOI and grant/method-code namespaces; this should become a separate stratum in the null model rather than being pooled blindly with ordinary five-digit strings.

The trapped-ion conical-intersection experiment provides a high-value benchmark for reconstructing two-dimensional wavepacket densities and directly observing geometric-phase interference in programmable quantum dynamics.
information_updates.claims_boundary: 01300 is the DOI component, not the measured phase.

information_updates.finding: The ion-induced photon-spectroscopy paper provides real-time dose-dependent monitoring of implantation-driven compositional change in MgAl2O4 and LiNbO3 and is directly reusable as an irradiation/material-response validation precedent.

USGS code 01043 aggregates multiple trace-element digestion/spectrometry workflows and is useful as an analytical-method/provenance reference while simultaneously demonstrating method-code collision behavior.
